reviews.text: Our veterinarian for over 11 years. Dr. Rita is incredible, as professional as you could ever find and with a true love for animals. I've had the opportunity to try a few places and there's nothing like this one! I wouldn't trust my Mickey to anyone else.
Very good clinic, I strongly recommend. They care and they have reasonable prices comparing to other clinic I had before this one it’s the best.
Very poor on all levels; if you care about the well-being of your animals, avoid them.

I followed a stray cat named Lourenço until he recovered from Calicivirus in its most severe state. I then managed to find him a guardian, named Sofia, and he became a client of this veterinary hospital.
About 4 years later, he had recurring respiratory problems from Calicivirus, which is a virus that has no cure and can leave lasting effects if left untreated.
At this hospital, they made a wrong diagnosis and instead of prescribing an antibiotic, they prescribed an aerosol. As a result, Lourenço ended up dying suddenly on December 22nd, caused by respiratory problems, which could have been avoided with a correct diagnosis, and he would still be alive. If instead of a cat it had been a person, the person responsible for the diagnosis would be facing justice. As it is, they go unpunished.

Excellent service, admirable friendliness from the doctors and support staff.
Thank you for everything, Dr. Rita Esteves.

The best professionals. The love that Dr. Rita has for animals is beautiful to see and feel. I recommend this hospital to everyone I know. My animals have been regulars there for over 11 years. They adore her and I won't go anywhere else. ❤️

I am writing to express my profound dissatisfaction with the services provided by the veterinary clinic. Unfortunately, I have had extremely negative experiences over time, which leads me to question the quality and professionalism of the veterinarians who work there.

Recently, my cat was ill and, when trying to schedule an appointment, I was informed by the receptionist that it would only be possible for the following week. My cat was a regular patient there. Unfortunately, the night before the scheduled appointment, he suffered a stroke and was rushed to the clinic. However, despite all efforts, he passed away this morning.

This loss has been devastating for me, as my cat was considered a member of the family. I feel that the lack of efficiency and professionalism on the part of the veterinarians contributed to this tragic outcome. When the motivation for practicing the profession is solely money, to the detriment of animal welfare and the quality of service provided, situations like this can occur.

I hope this feedback will be taken into consideration so that improvements can be implemented at the clinic, ensuring more efficient and compassionate care for all animals and their owners.

Excellent service and professionalism from everyone. Dr. Rita is undoubtedly an incredible and super attentive professional.
I will return and recommend your services. Kisses, see you soon with kisses from Valentino. P.S. Photo of Chico, the resident of the space 😊 5 stars …
They take very good care of my dog ​​whenever I need emergency care. They are also attentive and helpful.
For 13 years I've been taking my dog ​​there! Even though I no longer work in Alvalade, it remains the place where I trust to leave my Zaky.

I like the veterinarian, but there's only one, when they clearly need more. Making an appointment or not makes no difference, because I don't think they ever kept to a schedule and I always waited at least half an hour to be seen. This time I left anyway, after a 40-minute delay, and there wasn't even anyone at the entrance to tell me I couldn't stay any longer.
